THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 9 · Great cavern
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

The hall opens around long stone tables and cold braziers. Stairs climb to ledges at either end, above a floor scattered with the remains of an ancient battle.

Cold braziers offer no warmth to the long tables. The stairs and ledges at either end rise above the scattered remains, giving the chamber more than one level to watch. Anything moving across the open floor would be difficult to overlook from above.

Ask the players

What light or noise have you brought? Do you cross the lower floor, climb a ledge, or watch the shadows first?
